name: vaid
description: The VAID standard — Verifiable Agent Identity. Signed, short-lived, offline-verifiable credentials for agents, with capability attenuation across delegation chains.

plugins.name: vaid
plugins.description: Mint, present, verify and revoke VAIDs. Four verbs over the published vaid-mint SDK: verification is offline, needs only a public key, and reports authenticity, expiry, delegation and issuer identity separately — and always reports that revocation was NOT checked, because there is no published revocation list.
